name: Scriptorum
description: A chamber of arcane scholarship where wizards transcribe, study, and refine their spellwork. Upgrading the Scriptorum unlocks deeper levels of card mastery.

tiers.description: Basic spell transcription. Cards can be refined to Stage 1: core improvements to damage, range, and cost.
Advanced scholarship. Cards can be specialized to Stage 2: choose a playstyle branch that shapes how your spell develops.

Master transcription. Cards can be brought to Stages 3 and 4: deep transformation of your spells into their final forms. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. Refinement: once each timeline, one card may bring both halves to their final stage.

doctrines.name: Refinement
doctrines.description: A deep, precise deck. Once each timeline, one card takes a seventh upgrade point, for good: enough for both halves to reach Stage 4, where every other card must choose which half goes all the way.

doctrines.name: Dissemination
doctrines.description: Your study becomes the kingdom's arsenal: upgrades reach allied wizards' signature slots.
doctrines.blocked: signature slots in the deck editor are not built yet
